## Domain analysis and decisions

### Case for change and target behaviors (`case_for_change`)

State the current problem, why change is needed, and observable new behaviors.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Stakeholder segments and readiness (`stakeholders`)

Segment by impact, influence, readiness, and resistance rather than department alone.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Guiding coalition (`coalition`)

Define actions and decisions for sponsors, managers, and champions.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Communication engagement and training (`communications`)

Plan activities by audience, target behavior, channel, cadence, and feedback closure.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Obstacles and early wins (`obstacles`)

Track process friction, support needs, early wins, and scaling conditions.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Adoption funnel and business outcomes (`adoption`)

Define population, window, and targets for reach, trial, sustained use, and business outcomes.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Reinforcement handoff and improvement (`reinforcement`)

Define manager reinforcement, feedback adjustments, operating handoff, and evidence of retiring old practice.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Stage gates and acceptance (`acceptance_evidence`)

Use behavior and outcome evidence to decide progress, adjustment, or hold.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
